description: Use this when the user asks for the best AI tools for a task, niche or category — "best AI meeting notes tools", "top AI video editors", "what should I use for logo design". Returns our ranked list for the topic: the same ranking our "Best AI tools for X" pages use — topic match, real-user mentions, how often AI engines read each tool, and viability, with a founder-reviewed consensus list as a sanity gate. A #1 is named ONLY when the leader clears that gate; otherwise the answer says no single top pick is warranted. Every tool carries its pricing model, viability score and page. Not for: a single named tool (use check_tool_status), two named tools (compare_tools), or a described need with hard filters (recommend_tools).

limit.description: How many tools to return (3–15, default 10).

topic.description: The task, niche or category — e.g. "meeting notes", "video editing", "customer support chatbots".

name: best_for
title: The best AI tools for a topic, ranked
